newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia starts formal diamond producer probe - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russia starts formal diamond producer probe - Tass.

text.p: Russia's tax police have formally begun probing the Almazy Rossii-Sakha diamond producer, partner to De Beers in a gem export deal awaiting government approval, the official Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday.

Tass did not make clear whether the Federal Tax Police Service had formally charged ARS with alleged financial irregularities that were first raised by the prosecutor-general's office earlier this month.

A long-delayed diamond export agreement between De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd and ARS is awaiting government approval, but ARS officials have said the accusations of alleged financial irregularities could hold it up.
But some officials have said that a deal could be signed in December.
ARS supplies a quarter of De Beers output, produces nearly all of Russia's diamonds and is Russia's sole authorised exporter. It had $1.38 billion in sales last year.
